title: Beer — the Beverage that Heals Labor
thesis: Beer read as the dream that soothes labour, forking from one ancient stem. Born of the gods in Mesopotamia and made a wage in Egypt, brewing is kept alive by the medieval monasteries — then the modern age splits it in two: ALE, the warm-fermented soul of the Benelux abbeys, England's porter, and Poland's smoked grodziskie; and LAGER, the cold-fermented clarity of Vienna and Bavaria. Two rivers of the worker's cup, from one barley spring.
